name: Hotel de l'Opera Hanoi - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 107-room boutique hotel opened in 2011 on historic Trang Tien Street, a few hundred metres from Hoan Kiem Lake and the Hanoi Opera House.
ai_summary: Hotel de l'Opera Hanoi - MGallery Collection opened in 2011 on Trang Tien Street, a few hundred metres from both Hoan Kiem Lake and the Hanoi Opera House, in the heart of the city's French Quarter. The 107 rooms are dramatically decorated with slick wooden floors, jewel-toned furniture, and black marble-print wallpaper, drawing on 19th-century French design inspiration, alongside an indoor pool and fitness facilities. The hotel was voted Hanoi's No. 1 hotel by Travel + Leisure in 2024 and No. 2 in 2025, with guests consistently praising the warm, professional bellhop and front-desk staff and the central location, though a May-August 2025 renovation brought temporary noise and light disturbances for some guests during that window.

faqs.question: Is Hotel de l'Opera Hanoi close to Hoan Kiem Lake?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's a few hundred metres from both Hoan Kiem Lake and the Hanoi Opera House on historic Trang Tien Street, in the heart of the city's French Quarter.

faqs.question: Has Hotel de l'Opera Hanoi won any recent awards?
faqs.answer: Yes -- Travel + Leisure voted it Hanoi's No. 1 hotel in 2024 and No. 2 in 2025, reflecting consistently strong guest satisfaction over consecutive years.
